{"diagnosis": "Fetch makes no progress: max_addr stays 0x00000000 vs expected advance through 256 NOP words, with TRAP: no progress and FAIL 0xdead. mem_done on line 376 stays low because it ANDs (mem_xfer && |mem_state && (...)) with (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst) instead of ORing them, so the memory FSM never completes. Trace wins; CONE_SLICE was empty so no cone refs apply.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -376,2 +376,2 @@
-	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) && (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
+	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) || (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
 			(!mem_la_firstword || (~&mem_rdata_latched[1:0] && mem_xfer));", "expected": "tohost PASS (not FAIL 0xdead), no TRAP: no progress, max_addr advances beyond 0x00000000"}
